<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 https://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

    <parent>
        <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
        <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-parent</artifactId>
        <version>3.3.4</version>
        <relativePath/>
    </parent>

    <groupId>com.example</groupId>
    <artifactId>spring-data-jpa-demo</artifactId>
    <version>0.0.1-SNAPSHOT</version>
    <name>spring-data-jpa-demo</name>
    <description>Spring Boot application persisting data with Spring Data JPA</description>

    <properties>
        <java.version>17</java.version>
    </properties>

    <dependencies>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-data-jpa</artifactId>
        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.h2database</groupId>
            <artifactId>h2</artifactId>
            <scope>runtime</scope>
        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-test</artifactId>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
    </dependencies>

    <build>
        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
                <artifactId>spring-boot-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>
</project>

spring.application.name=spring-data-jpa-demo

spring.datasource.url=jdbc:h2:mem:testdb;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1;DB_CLOSE_ON_EXIT=FALSE
spring.datasource.driver-class-name=org.h2.Driver
spring.datasource.username=sa
spring.datasource.password=

spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto=update
spring.jpa.show-sql=true
spring.jpa.open-in-view=false
spring.jpa.properties.hibernate.format_sql=true

spring.h2.console.enabled=true
spring.h2.console.path=/h2-console

Project scaffolded. Structure:

- `pom.xml` — Spring Boot 3.3.4 (Java 17) with `spring-boot-starter-data-jpa`, H2 runtime, test starter
- `src/main/java/com/example/demo/DemoApplication.java` — entry point
- `src/main/java/com/example/demo/domain/Customer.java` — JPA entity (`@Entity`, identity id, auditing timestamps)
- `src/main/java/com/example/demo/repository/CustomerRepository.java` — `JpaRepository` with derived queries
- `src/main/resources/application.properties` — H2 in-memory datasource, `ddl-auto=update`, H2 console
- `src/test/java/.../CustomerRepositoryTest.java` — `@DataJpaTest` coverage

Note: `java`/`mvn` aren't installed in this environment, so I couldn't run `mvn test`. Once the toolchain is available, verify with:

```
mvn test
mvn spring-boot:run
```

For a real database, swap the H2 dependency for e.g. `org.postgresql:postgresql` and update `spring.datasource.*`.
